_doc: Sections (or single elements of a section) attached hidden and inert outside <main> before the runtime starts, for modules that span pages. See docs/runtime-adaptations.md. Phase 3 replaces these with data modules.

all.why: The Infographic button on every page uses the studio's renderer, which only starts when #igStudio exists.

why.caio-tools: One module (CAIO tools) runs all six CAIO pages and returns early unless #caio exists; the tools read each other (portfolio → strategy, board pack).
why.industry: 'Model the ROI' and 'Add to portfolio' call the CAIO tools (window.__arSet, __ucAdd), which save through their own render.
why.ai-board: The board pack appends the incident register (window.__bpExtra), defined by the incidents module.
why.proposal: The proposal uses the ROI model (window.__arModel) and the decision wizard's last result (window.__dwLast).
